lines.text: So the Peony Association, instead of receiving financial remuneration, has been receiving various items as payment.
Those items were then sold to fund your operations,
but now both the money and the items have been depleted.

lines.speaker: moran
lines.text: That about sums it up.

lines.speaker: moran
lines.text: You sure pick up information quickly!
About how much would you say you need?

lines.speaker: moran
lines.text: Let me think...

lines.speaker: moran
lines.text: We have three missions scheduled for next week, but to last until then... 500,000 credits or so?

lines.speaker: moran
lines.text: I know that's a hefty sum...
I'll lend it to you.

lines.speaker: moran
lines.text: Wh-what? Really?

lines.speaker: moran
lines.text: Are you loaded or something?
Not exactly, but I can swing that.
I'll have to tighten my belt a bit, but I can lend that to you.

lines.speaker: moran
lines.text: I admire your loyalty!

lines.speaker: moran
lines.text: Wait, no.

lines.speaker: moran
lines.text: I can't borrow money from you. This isn't right.

lines.speaker: moran
lines.text: I'll just take solace in the fact you were willing to do it.

lines.speaker: moran
lines.text: How about taking me to the Ark and trying to send some jobs my way?

lines.speaker: moran
lines.text: Something temporary, or something I can do part-time.

lines.speaker: moran
lines.text: Any money I earn, I want to earn on my own.

lines.speaker: moran
lines.text: Only then will I be able to face everyone with my head held high.
All right, are there any jobs in particular that you have your eye on?

lines.speaker: moran
lines.text: Jobs?

lines.speaker: moran
lines.text: Hmm...

lines.speaker: moran
lines.text: Hmmmmm...
Can you not think of anything?

lines.speaker: moran
lines.text: No, that's not it.

lines.speaker: moran
lines.text: It's just that I'm used to dealing with seedy elements in the Outer Rim, so I'm not sure how to transfer those skills to other areas.

lines.speaker: moran
lines.text: Oh, I've got it! How about sales?
Sales?

lines.speaker: moran
lines.text: Yeah! I work with people a lot in my line of work.

lines.speaker: moran
lines.text: I'm good with people, so I'm sure I could chat them up and sell merchandise.
Let's see... in that case...
*Ring*

lines.speaker: mica
lines.text: Old-Timer!

lines.speaker: belorta
lines.text: Welcome!

lines.speaker: belorta
lines.text: We've been waiting for you.

lines.speaker: moran
lines.text: You brought me to a toy store?
I figured you might have some luck peddling merchandise here.
I already talked it over with Belorta and Mica, and they're okay with it.

lines.speaker: belorta
lines.text: Yeah, we'd be glad to have you.

lines.speaker: mica
lines.text: I'm sure you'll do just fine.

lines.speaker: belorta
lines.text: Ah!

lines.speaker: belorta
lines.text: Our salaries are commission-based here,

lines.speaker: belorta
lines.text: so you can earn more or less depending on how well you do.

lines.speaker: moran
lines.text: So if I make the store a million credits in profit, I get to take a million credits for myself?

lines.speaker: belorta
lines.text: That's right.

lines.speaker: moran
lines.text: Each and every credit, too! No deductions.

lines.speaker: belorta
lines.text: Yep yep.

lines.speaker: moran
lines.text: Wow, that's amazing!

lines.speaker: moran
lines.text: I'll try and aim for 3 million today.

lines.speaker: belorta
lines.text: A lofty goal! Best of luck to you.

lines.speaker: mica
lines.text: I just hope that enough customers come...

lines.speaker: moran
lines.text: Ha, I'll leave drumming up the customers to you.
Moran and I stayed at the Toy Store for three hours, but...
Where is everyone?
Not a single customer comes in.

lines.speaker: moran
lines.text: What the heck is going on?

lines.speaker: moran
lines.text: Is this place normally this dead?

lines.speaker: belorta
lines.text: Oh yeah, we've had times where a single soul didn't come in for a whole week.

lines.speaker: mica
lines.text: That's right...

lines.speaker: mica
lines.text: Maybe we should make some promotional items or something.

lines.speaker: moran
lines.text: Cadet, I say we blow this joint.

lines.speaker: moran
lines.text: At this rate, we're not gonna earn a single credit.
Yeah, let's go somewhere else.

lines.speaker: moran
lines.text: All right!

lines.speaker: moran
lines.text: I think that might be better for us.

lines.speaker: moran
lines.text: Besides, even if I do make money here, it'll feel like I'm taking it out of children's hands.

lines.speaker: moran
lines.text: What's this place?
It's the Maid Cafe.
They've always got plenty of customers, so you don't have to worry about that.

lines.speaker: moran
lines.text: Oh! Really? Now I'm getting excited!
*Tudadadada*

lines.speaker: cocoa
lines.text: Welcome, Master!

lines.speaker: cocoa
lines.text: I've been waiting for you.

lines.speaker: soda
lines.text: Welcome, Master.

lines.speaker: soda
lines.text: Since Ade was out on business, I was worried how we were going to get by.

lines.speaker: soda
lines.text: You bringing in a part-timer is a real windfall for us.

lines.speaker: soda
lines.text: Thanks so much!

lines.speaker: cocoa
lines.text: Yeah, we could really use an extra pair of hands around here.

lines.speaker: moran
lines.text: That's perfect, 'cause I'm looking for work.

lines.speaker: moran
lines.text: What can I help with?

lines.speaker: cocoa
lines.text: You can start by serving up this omurice that I made.

lines.speaker: cocoa
lines.text: It's going to that customer over there in the striped t-shirt.

lines.speaker: moran
lines.text: Okay,

lines.speaker: moran
lines.text: no problem!

lines.speaker: moran
lines.text: Sit back and watch, Cadet. I'm gonna nail this.
Good luck.
Moran approaches the customer while holding the omurice.
*Thud*

lines.speaker: moran
lines.text: Here you go, fresh omurice made by Cocoa. Enjoy!

lines.speaker: cameraman
lines.text: Er...

lines.speaker: cameraman
lines.text: Erm... Could you perhaps...

lines.speaker: moran
lines.text: What?

lines.speaker: cameraman
lines.text: Aren't you going to say the spell?

lines.speaker: moran
lines.text: Huh? What spell?

lines.speaker: cameraman
lines.text: The spell to make it delicious.

lines.speaker: moran
lines.text: What are you talking about?

lines.speaker: moran
lines.text: Can't you do it yourself before you eat it?

lines.speaker: cameraman
lines.text: Wh-what are you talking about?

lines.speaker: cameraman
lines.text: That's what the maids are supposed to do!

lines.speaker: cameraman
lines.text: It's part of the service!

lines.speaker: cameraman
lines.text: How can you expect me to say it?!
The customer's face is slowly starting to go beet red.
I've got to do something before the situation spirals out of control.

lines.speaker: soda
lines.text: Oh dear...

lines.speaker: soda
lines.text: My apologies! I believe one of our maids has made a mistake.

lines.speaker: cocoa
lines.text: We're very sorry.

lines.speaker: cocoa
lines.text: She's new here.

lines.speaker: cocoa
lines.text: Why don't Soda and I recite the spell for you?

lines.speaker: soda
lines.text: May this dish be delicious. Alakazam!

lines.speaker: cocoa
lines.text: May this dish be delicious. Alakazam!

lines.speaker: moran
lines.text: ... You can't be serious.

lines.speaker: moran
lines.text: I've got to chant that spell every time I serve someone something?
If you want to make money, then that's what you'll have to do.
Just close your eyes and try it.
*Ring*

lines.speaker: soda
lines.text: Welcome!

lines.speaker: cocoa
lines.text: Welcome.

lines.speaker: moran
lines.text: Not another customer...

lines.speaker: peonian
lines.text: Moran?

lines.speaker: peonian
lines.text: Is that you?

lines.speaker: moran
lines.text: Wh-what are you doing here?!

lines.speaker: peonian
lines.text: I came to see Soda...

lines.speaker: moran
lines.text: Cadet.

lines.speaker: moran
lines.text: I don't think I can work here.
Moran's subsequent stint at the cafe doesn't go too well.

lines.speaker: glasseswoman
lines.text: Can I get three Sugar Coffees, two Milk Coffees, and four Cream Coffees?

lines.speaker: moran
lines.text: Three... two... and four... That'll be 15,000 credits.

lines.speaker: glasseswoman
lines.text: Um... shouldn't it be 20,000?

lines.speaker: moran
lines.text: Huh?

lines.speaker: milk
lines.text: Stop right there.

lines.speaker: milk
lines.text: Can you please explain to me why you can't work out simple math?

lines.speaker: milk
lines.text: This is your 10th time getting it wrong!

lines.speaker: frima
lines.text: You.

lines.speaker: frima
lines.text: Are fired.
We looked for other places Moran could work, but...

lines.speaker: dolla
lines.text: I don't think you're the right fit for the Shopping Mall. Perhaps you should look elsewhere.

lines.speaker: yan
lines.text: Sorry, I haven't got anything for you.

lines.speaker: rupee
lines.text: Sorry, maybe you can ask someone else.

lines.speaker: mary
lines.text: Only healthcare workers can work here.

lines.speaker: centi
lines.text: Working here requires a certain skillset. Not just anyone can work here.
We were rejected at every turn.
*Swooosh*

lines.speaker: moran
lines.text: Making money is harder than I thought.

lines.speaker: moran
lines.text: Is it even possible?

lines.speaker: moran
lines.text: How do I even start...
I rack my brain to come up with ways Moran can make money.
My eyes catch a small flyer.
*Swoosh*

lines.speaker: moran
lines.text: Hey, where are you going?
Look at this.
You might be able to make some money with this.

lines.speaker: moran
lines.text: What is it?

lines.speaker: moran
lines.text: We retrieve your money?
